title: Codex hooks configuration
description:
Configuration for OpenAI Codex lifecycle hooks.
https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for Codex hooks configuration.

description.description: Human-readable description of the hooks file.

hooks.description: Hook event registrations grouped by Codex lifecycle event.

SessionStart.description: Runs when a new session starts. The matcher filters `startup`, `resume`, `clear`, and `compact`.

PreToolUse.description: Runs before a tool executes. The matcher filters `Bash`, `apply_patch`, and MCP tool names.

PermissionRequest.description: Runs when permission is requested. The matcher filters `Bash`, `apply_patch`, and MCP tool names.

PostToolUse.description: Runs after a tool executes. The matcher filters `Bash`, `apply_patch`, and MCP tool names.

PreCompact.description: Runs before context compaction. The matcher filters `manual` or `auto`.

PostCompact.description: Runs after context compaction. The matcher filters `manual` or `auto`.

SubagentStart.description: Runs when a subagent is created. The matcher filters the subagent type.

SubagentStop.description: Runs before a subagent ends its turn. The matcher filters the subagent type.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Runs when the user submits a prompt. Codex currently ignores matcher for this event.

Stop.description: Runs when a turn stops. Codex currently ignores matcher for this event.

matcherGroup.description: Matcher group that decides when one or more hook handlers run.

matcher.description: Regex string that filters when hooks fire. Use *, an empty string, or omit matcher to match every supported occurrence.

hooks.description: Handlers to run when this matcher group matches.

nonMatcherGroup.description: Matcher group that decides when one or more hook handlers run.

hooks.description: Handlers to run when this matcher group matches.

commandHandler.description: Command hook handler. Commands run with the session cwd as their working directory.

type.description: Command handlers are the only hook handler type that runs in the current Codex runtime.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Codex uses 600 seconds when omitted.

statusMessage.description: Optional status text shown while the hook runs.

async.description: Parsed by Codex, but async command hooks are not supported yet and async handlers are skipped.

skippedHandler.description: Prompt and agent handlers are parsed by Codex but skipped in the current runtime.
